title: Dyed Flames Modded Compat
description: Dyed Flames compat for modded fire types
body:
This requires **Dyed Flames** to properly work: https://modrinth.com/mod/dyed-flames 

Currently it only adds compat for _Livng Fire_ from **Dungeon's Delight** https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons_delight

![hot hot hot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67de92f31746dfb8c9318ad39118d86d7a6f8c77.png)

Planned compat for these mods once they are eventually ported to 1.21.1
- Caverns and Chasms (_Cupric Fire_)
- Endergetic Expansion (_Ender Fire_)
- Jaden's Nether Expansion (_Ancient Fire_)

I'll probably add compat for other mods i find but dont count on it
